name: Roarcurrent Gorge
introDiscord:
Currents rushing through hollow Leviathan bones produce a deep roar
that echoes across the gorge.

Roarcurrent Sirens learned to sing with it.
introTwitch:
Currents rushing through hollow Leviathan bones produce a deep roar
that echoes across the gorge.

Roarcurrent Sirens learned to sing with it.

roarcurrent-gorge-approach.prompt: Three routes pass between hollow ribs humming with low sound.

left.message: Star Candies rest inside a hollow scale pocket.

right.message:
Shizuki's bottle sits beneath her review:

'Giant bone flute.

Beautiful.

Loud.

Would not recommend sleeping beside.'

forward.message:
A Siren's voice joins the roaring bone.

Then its owner appears.

roarcurrent-gorge-depths.prompt: The gorge becomes a natural concert hall.

left.message:
A Roarcurrent Siren matches the note of a hollow rib perfectly before
turning the performance toward you.

right.message:
One Berry rests beside Shizuki's attempt at sheet music:

'RRRRRRRROOOOOOOOAAAARRRRRR.

Accurate transcription.'

forward.message: A navigator's chest lies inside a resonant bone hollow.

left.message: A wrecked strongbox rests beneath the roaring water.

right.message:
A Siren emerges from behind an enormous vertebra while the entire gorge
harmonizes.

forward.message:
Shizuki's bottle reads:

'Concert recovery.

Ear recovery unavailable.'

bossPromptDiscord:
The gorge falls quiet.

One voice remains.

It begins softly.

Then the entire Leviathan skeleton answers it.

Use /yes to enter Howling Scar or /no to leave before the final chorus.
bossPromptTwitch:
The gorge falls quiet.

One voice remains.

It begins softly.

Then the entire Leviathan skeleton answers it.

Use !yes to enter Howling Scar or !no to leave before the final chorus.

boss.revealText:
A powerful Siren rises through the roaring current.

Tempest-Voice Siren reveals itself!

completionText:
The Siren's song fades.

The bones keep humming long after it is gone.
